About AEIVC关于 AEIVC

Who we are, and why the competition exists.我们是谁，以及这项比赛为何而设立。

Greeting致辞 Mission使命
Greeting致辞

Welcome to AEIVC欢迎来到 AEIVC

The Asia-Europe International Vocal Competition was founded on a simple conviction: talent should not be limited by distance.亚欧国际声乐比赛源于一个朴素的信念：才华不应被距离所限。

Across Asia, a remarkable generation of classical singers is ready for the international stage. Yet for many of them, the path to Europe — where Opera was born and where its traditions remain most alive — is long, costly and uncertain. AEIVC exists to shorten that path.在亚洲，新一代优秀的古典声乐演唱者已经做好了走向国际舞台的准备。然而，对许多人而言，通往欧洲——歌剧的诞生地、其传统至今最为鲜活的地方——的道路漫长、昂贵且充满不确定。AEIVC 的使命，正是缩短这段距离。

By holding the competition through online video auditions, we allow every singer of Asian nationality to take part from home, without the burden of travel, and to be heard by an international jury under one and the same artistic standard.比赛以线上视频形式进行，让每一位亚洲国籍的歌唱家无需承担旅途负担，即可在家中参赛，并由国际评委团以同一艺术标准进行评审。

Above all, AEIVC is a competition that leads to a stage. Our winners do not simply receive a title — they perform with professional orchestras on world-class stages, and step into a wider international network of conductors, orchestras and competitions.最重要的是，AEIVC 是一项通向舞台的比赛。获奖者获得的不只是一个头衔——他们将与职业乐团合作，登上世界级的舞台，并由此进入更广阔的国际网络，结识指挥家、乐团与更多国际比赛。

We warmly welcome every singer who shares this dream, and we look forward to hearing your voice.我们诚挚欢迎每一位怀有同样梦想的歌唱家，期待聆听你的声音。

— Prof. Inhye Kim
Jury Chair · General Director, AEIVC— Inhye Kim 教授
评委会主席 · AEIVC 总监

Mission使命

Opening a path from Asia to the European stage开辟一条从亚洲通往欧洲舞台的道路

AEIVC exists to discover outstanding classical singers of Asian nationality and to connect them directly with European orchestras, conductors and audiences.AEIVC致力于发掘优秀的亚洲国籍古典声乐人才，并将他们与欧洲的乐团、指挥家和观众直接相连。

We believe that a competition should lead to a stage. That is why each AEIVC edition culminates in a Winners' Concert in Europe.我们相信，比赛应当通向舞台。因此，AEIVC的每一期比赛都将以在欧洲举行的获奖者音乐会作为最终成果。

01

Discover发掘

Find exceptional Asian voices through an accessible online video competition with no age limit.通过便捷的线上视频比赛发掘杰出的亚洲声乐人才，不设年龄限制。

02

Connect连接

Link Asian singers with European orchestras, conductors and concert halls.让亚洲歌唱家与欧洲的乐团、指挥家和音乐厅建立联系。

03

Perform登台

Give every winner a real performance with orchestra, before a European audience.让每一位获奖者都能与乐团合作，在欧洲观众面前真正登台演出。

02 · Repertoire & Video02 · 曲目与视频

Two arias. No editing.两首咏叹调，不得剪辑。

A

Repertoire曲目

  • Two Opera arias of your own choice.自选两首歌剧咏叹调。
  • Sung in the original language and in the original key — no transposition.必须以原文、原调演唱，不得移调。
  • No time limit.不设时间限制。
  • Live piano or live orchestra accompaniment only; backing tracks are not permitted.仅限现场钢琴或现场乐队伴奏，不得使用伴奏音轨（MR）。
B

Recording录制

  • Record both arias in one continuous video, or each aria in a separate video — both are accepted.两首咏叹调可连续录制为一个视频，也可每首单独录制一个视频，两种方式均可。
  • No editing of any kind: no cuts, no combining of takes and no adjustment of sound or picture.严禁任何形式的剪辑或后期处理：不得剪切、拼接，也不得调整声音或画面。
  • Recorded on or after 1 January 2026.须为2026年1月1日（含）以后录制。
  • Fixed camera (no zoom or movement); the singer's full body and the accompanist must both be visible.机位固定（不得变焦或移动）；画面中须同时完整呈现演唱者全身及伴奏者。
  • AI-generated or AI-altered performances and deepfakes are strictly prohibited.严禁使用AI生成或AI修改的演唱内容及深度伪造技术。
C

Submission提交

  • Submit a link from which the jury can download your video(s) directly — no sign-in, app or verification required. Any service may be used (e.g. Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive).请提交评委可直接下载视频的链接——无需登录、无需安装应用、无需任何验证。可使用任意平台（如 Google Drive、Dropbox、OneDrive 等）。
  • Keep the link active until the results are announced.链接须保持有效，直至结果公布。
  • File name: E1_Voice_LastName_FirstName_Country.mp4 for Edition I, E2_… for Edition II. For two separate videos, add _1 and _2 — e.g. E1_Voice_Wang_Li_China_1.mp4.文件命名：第一期为 E1_Voice_LastName_FirstName_Country.mp4，第二期为 E2_…（姓名请使用英文或拼音）。如分两个视频提交，请在末尾加 _1、_2，例如 E1_Voice_Wang_Li_China_1.mp4。
03 · Application03 · 报名

Four steps四个步骤

01

Prepare准备

Record your two arias and create a download link.录制两首咏叹调，并生成可下载链接。

02

Apply填写报名表

Complete the online form for the edition you are entering (one form per edition): your name in English exactly as in your passport, the arias (title, Opera, composer) and your video link.填写所报名期次的在线报名表（每期单独报名）：填写与护照一致的英文姓名、曲目信息（咏叹调名称、歌剧名、作曲家）及视频链接。

03

Pay缴费

Pay the entry fee of CNY 1,400 at the end of the form.在报名表末尾缴纳报名费人民币1,400元。

04

Confirmation确认

You receive a confirmation email once payment is confirmed — only then is your application complete. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder, then contact us.付款确认后您将收到确认邮件，此时报名方为完成。如未收到，请先检查垃圾邮件箱，再与我们联系。

Regulations比赛章程

Competition Regulations比赛章程

By applying, the applicant agrees to the following Regulations.提交报名即表示参赛者同意以下章程。

Article 1第1条

General总则

  1. AEIVC is an international online video competition for classical singers, held in two independent editions — Edition I (Lake Como, Italy) and Edition II (Concertgebouw, Netherlands). Each edition has its own application period, evaluation, results and Winners' Concert.AEIVC 是面向古典声乐演唱者的国际线上视频比赛，分为两期独立举办——第一期（意大利科莫湖）与第二期（荷兰阿姆斯特丹音乐厅）。每期均有各自的报名期、评审、结果公布及获奖者音乐会。
  2. All dates and times refer to Beijing Time (UTC+8).所有日期与时间均以北京时间（UTC+8）为准。
  3. These Regulations are published in English and Chinese. In case of any discrepancy, the English version prevails.本章程以英文和中文发布。如有歧义，以英文版本为准。
Article 2第2条

Eligibility参赛资格

  1. The Competition is open exclusively to classical singers of Asian nationality.本比赛仅限亚洲国籍的古典声乐演唱者参加。
  2. There is no age limit. All applicants are judged by the same artistic standard.不设年龄限制，所有参赛者均按同一艺术标准评审。
  3. Applicants may enter one or both editions. Each edition requires a separate application and entry fee.参赛者可报名其中一期或两期，每期须单独报名并缴纳报名费。
Article 3第3条

Application & Entry Fee报名与报名费

  1. Applications are accepted through the official online form during the application period of each edition (see How to Apply). Applicants who are unable to apply or pay online may apply by email to aeivc.official@gmail.com and pay the entry fee by bank transfer.报名须在各期报名期内（见“报名方式”）通过官方在线报名表提交。如无法在线报名或付款，可发送电子邮件至 aeivc.official@gmail.com 报名，并通过银行转账缴纳报名费。
  2. The entry fee is CNY 1,400 per edition. There is a single eight-week application period with no early-bird rate.每期报名费为人民币1,400元。每期仅设一个为期八周的报名期，不设早鸟价。
  3. An application is complete only when the form has been submitted and the payment has been confirmed.报名表提交且付款确认后，报名方为完成。
  4. The applicant's name must be written in English exactly as in the passport. If the fee is paid by another person, the payer's name must be entered in the designated field.参赛者姓名须使用与护照完全一致的英文填写。如由他人代缴报名费，须在指定栏填写付款人姓名。
  5. Entry fees are non-refundable, except when an edition is cancelled by the Organizer. Transaction and transfer fees are borne by the applicant.报名费一经缴纳概不退还，主办方取消该期比赛的情况除外。交易及转账手续费由参赛者承担。
  6. Submitted applications cannot be changed. If duplicates are received, only the first submission is evaluated.已提交的报名不可修改。如重复报名，仅评审首次提交的内容。
Article 4第4条

Repertoire & Video曲目与视频

  1. The Repertoire, Recording and Submission requirements set out under How to Apply form part of these Regulations.“报名方式”中所列“曲目、录制与提交”要求为本章程的组成部分。
Article 5第5条

Jury & Evaluation评审

  1. Videos are evaluated by an international jury chaired by Prof. Inhye Kim, General Director of AEIVC.视频由AEIVC总监 Inhye Kim 教授担任主席的国际评委团进行评审。
  2. The jury evaluates musicality, vocal technique, interpretation, expression and overall artistry.评审标准包括音乐性、发声技巧、诠释、表现力及整体艺术性。
  3. The decisions of the jury are final; appeals are not accepted.评委团的决定为最终决定，不接受申诉。
Article 6第6条

Results结果公布

  1. Results are announced separately for each edition on the dates set out under How to Apply, and are published on the Winners page of the website.各期结果按“报名方式”所列日期分别公布，并发布于官网“获奖者”页面。
Article 7第7条

Prizes & Benefits奖项与权益

  1. Edition I — The 1st and 2nd Prize winners perform at the Winners' Concert on 2 June 2027 at PalaSole, Bellano (Lake Como), Italy, with the Lake Como Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Roberto Gianola. Programme: Opera arias.第一期——第一名和第二名获奖者将于2027年6月2日在意大利科莫湖贝拉诺 PalaSole 举行的获奖者音乐会上，与 Roberto Gianola 指挥的科莫湖爱乐乐团合作演出。曲目：歌剧咏叹调。
  2. Edition I Special Award — The 1st Prize winner is invited as a Finalist of the 11th Lake Como International Opera Competition (August 2027), presented by CANTO LIRICO | Lake Como Academy, partner competition of AEIVC.第一期特别奖——第一名获奖者将受邀作为决赛选手，参加由AEIVC合作比赛方 CANTO LIRICO | Lake Como Academy 主办的第11届科莫湖国际歌剧比赛（2027年8月）。
  3. Edition II — The 1st Prize winner performs on 22 October 2027 at the Scheldetheater, Terneuzen, and on 23 October 2027 at the Concertgebouw, Amsterdam, with the Sofia Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Nayden Todorov. Programme to be announced.第二期——第一名获奖者将于2027年10月22日在特尔讷曾斯海尔德剧院、10月23日在阿姆斯特丹音乐厅，与 Nayden Todorov 指挥的索菲亚爱乐乐团合作演出。曲目待公布。
  4. Accommodation and airport pick-up and drop-off are provided for the official concert schedule. Travel costs, including airfare, are not covered.主办方按官方日程提供住宿及机场接送服务。往返交通费用（含机票）不予承担。
  5. All prize winners receive an official certificate and a basic video recording of their concert for documentation purposes.所有获奖者将获得官方获奖证书，以及一份用于存档证明的基础音乐会演出视频。
  6. The conductor and orchestra may change depending on local circumstances.指挥及乐团可能因当地情况而有所变动。
Article 8第8条

Winner Obligations获奖者义务

  1. When requested by the Organizer, winners submit a copy of their passport, a biography of 100–150 words, a profile photo and their performance programme. These are not required at the application stage.获奖者须在主办方要求时提交护照复印件、100–150词个人简介、个人照片及演出曲目。报名阶段无需提交。
Article 9第9条

Disqualification取消资格

  1. An application may be disqualified for false information (including nationality), violation of the repertoire or video requirements, misconduct, copyright infringement or any other breach of these Regulations.如存在虚假信息（包括国籍）、违反曲目或视频要求、不当行为、侵犯版权或其他违反本章程的情况，将被取消参赛资格。
Article 10第10条

Copyright & Personal Data版权与个人信息

  1. Applicants agree that their submitted videos and photographs may be used by the Organizer to promote the Competition.参赛者同意主办方可将其提交的视频和照片用于比赛宣传。
  2. Copyright in the performed works remains with the respective rights holders.演唱作品的版权归各自权利人所有。
  3. Personal data is used solely for the administration of the Competition.个人信息仅用于比赛管理。
